svg.title: Two interfaces in a narrow cone leave a long region for the leftover labels
svg.desc: A centre x with its unit circle dashed. Two short segments K1 and K2 of length 0.3 (exaggerated) leave x in directions 20 degrees above and below east, 40 degrees apart. Their straddle regions are shaded blue and green; where they overlap, shaded red, labels 1, 2, 3 and 4 are all excluded, so only labels 5 and 6 could appear. The red overlap is a long thin crescent just outside the circle on the side the segments point to, with a matching crescent inside the circle on the far side.

g.text: Six labels. K₁ excludes {1,2} and K₂ excludes {3,4}. L = 0.3, exaggerated.
Blue: Δ(K₁), no 1 or 2. Green: Δ(K₂), no 3 or 4. Red: in both.
Red hugs the dashed circle around x; up to zero area, only 5 and 6 can appear there.
CC60 says this configuration cannot occur.
